listing.title: Phool Cosmos Gin Soy Candle
listing.body_text:
Fragrance Notes: Ginger, Sweet Orange, Bergamot, Cardamom, Lavender, Chamomile

Features:

A refreshing and lively blend of spicy ginger and zesty sweet orange, perfectly balanced with soft, calming florals. This uplifting fragrance adds a touch of energy and peace to any space, making it ideal for moments of relaxation or a boost of freshness.

•
Crafted with lead-free wicks for a cleaner, smoother burn with no soot or harmful toxins.

•
Convenient twist-on lid to preserve freshness and ensure long-lasting fragrance.

•
Made from 100% pure soy wax for an eco-friendly, natural burn that you can feel good about.

Why You’ll Love It:

The Phool Cosmos Gin Candle offers a luxurious, soothing escape with its harmonious blend of warming ginger, citrusy freshness, and relaxing floral notes. Perfect for creating a calming environment to unwind after a hectic day or to simply refresh your space with a peaceful ambiance.

•
Perfect Gift: Ideal for anyone who loves fresh, aromatic, and thoughtfully crafted scents.

•
Hand-poured with Care: Each candle is made with precision and dedication to deliver a high-quality, toxin-free experience.

•
Sustainable & Eco-friendly: Enjoy the glow with a clear conscience, knowing that this candle is created with pure soy wax, making it kind to the environment.

For the Best Burn:

For optimal enjoyment, light your Phool Cosmos Gin Candle for 1-2 hours at a time. This will allow you to bask in its full fragrance without any smoke, creating an inviting and soothing atmosphere wherever you go.

Create a serene, peaceful haven with the Phool Cosmos Gin Candle—sometimes all it takes is a little light to restore balance and calm your senses.

Eco-friendly | Hand-poured | Lead-free wick | 100% Pure Soy Wax
